history.value: After Act 1 is done the headline's offer pool widens to the cards the engine holds, with its controls built once then (not before); reads of nets trained on new content on it use cross comparison (--match or crossed arms); the value chooser is its chooser once a net has trained on the pool, after backlog value-chooser-path (every encounter the sequence can still meet, states valued before the opening hand); an exact-over-hands chooser is rejected; what the held-out half becomes is open.
